title: Climate → Food/Energy → Inflation → Fed → UST/Financial Conditions → AI Capital Cycle
purpose: Track whether climate/resource pressure is becoming a validated multi-link financial/technology transmission chain.

nodes.label: Climate / El Niño
nodes.description: ENSO intensity, climate anomalies and associated physical constraints.

nodes.label: Food & Energy Pressure
nodes.description: Food-price and energy-price/resource stress potentially linked to climate/resource constraints.

nodes.label: Inflation / Inflation Expectations
nodes.description: Observed and expected inflation response to food/energy pressure.

nodes.label: Fed / Monetary Policy
nodes.description: Federal Reserve reaction function and policy-path repricing.

nodes.label: UST Long End / Financial Conditions / Fiscal Pressure
nodes.description: 10Y/30Y Treasury yields, term premium, financing conditions and fiscal-duration pressure.

nodes.label: AI CapEx / Tech Valuation / Financing Stress
nodes.description: AI infrastructure spending, financing conditions and technology-asset valuation sensitivity.

links.mechanism: Climate anomalies affect agricultural output, hydropower/resource availability and selected energy/food markets.
links.persistence_note: Impact is geography-, crop-, season- and energy-system-specific; broad global transmission is not automatic.

links.mechanism: Food and energy cost pressure transmits into headline inflation and may affect inflation expectations.
links.persistence_note: Second-round/core inflation effects require separate evidence.

links.mechanism: Persistent inflation risk changes the Federal Reserve reaction function and expected policy path.
links.persistence_note: Policy response also depends on labor markets, growth and financial stability.

links.mechanism: Policy expectations interact with term premium, Treasury supply and fiscal duration to alter long-end yields and financial conditions.
links.persistence_note: Long-end yields are not a mechanical function of the policy rate; fiscal/term-premium drivers must remain explicit.

links.mechanism: Higher long-duration financing costs and tighter credit conditions raise hurdle rates for AI infrastructure and compress rate-sensitive technology valuations.
links.persistence_note: Strong earnings/monetization or strategic financing can offset rate pressure; CapEx reversal requires direct evidence.
